summary:
Alphabet 營收與獲利皆超預期，EPS 達 9.11 美元，展現強勁的 AI 變現能力與廣告業務韌性。
• 每股盈餘 (EPS) 達 9.11 美元，大幅超越市場預期的 2.90 美元。
• 季度營收達 1,198 億美元，年增長率達 24.23%，顯示核心業務動能強勁。
• AI 技術整合持續提升搜尋與雲端運算（Google Cloud）的變現效率。
• 目前滾動本益比（Trailing PE）僅 17.03 倍，估值在科技巨頭中極具吸引力。
ai_view:
本季財報釋放極為強烈的看漲訊號。EPS 的爆發性成長與 24% 的營收年增率，證實 Alphabet 在 AI 投資的變現能力已進入收割期。目前僅 17 倍的本益比顯著低估其成長潛力，短中期內將吸引價值與成長型資金流入，推升股價。後續應密切追蹤 Google Cloud 的利潤率變化、資本支出（CapEx）增速，以及反壟斷訴訟的最新進展。

需留意：反壟斷監管壓力持續，可能面臨業務拆分或高額罰款風險。；AI 基礎設施的持續高額資本支出可能在中長期壓抑利潤率。

summary_en:
Alphabet delivered a massive earnings beat with EPS of $9.11 and 24.23% revenue growth, driven by strong AI monetization and advertising resilience.
• EPS reached $9.11, massively beating the consensus estimate of $2.90 by 214.23%.
• Quarterly revenue grew 24.23% YoY to $119.80B, demonstrating robust core business momentum.
• AI integration continues to drive monetization efficiency across Search and Google Cloud.
• Trailing PE of 17.03 suggests highly attractive valuation relative to its high-growth profile.

ai_view_en:
This report delivers an exceptionally strong bullish signal. The explosive EPS growth and 24% revenue expansion prove that Alphabet's AI investments are translating into high-margin returns. At a trailing PE of just 17x, the stock is significantly undervalued relative to its growth profile, which should drive near-to-mid-term re-rating. Key metrics to track going forward include Google Cloud margin expansion, CapEx trajectory, and regulatory antitrust developments.

Watch：Ongoing antitrust regulatory scrutiny poses risks of potential business breakups or heavy fines.; Sustained high capital expenditure on AI infrastructure could pressure margins in the medium term.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 遠超市場預期 214.23%，營收年增達 24.23% 展現強勁增長。
